title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_364.txt
concise_summary: PKD synthesizes seven years of theological reflection into a computational model of reality as a binary on/off pulsation system (0-1 flicker rate) through which God/VALIS selects optimally among possible states. Reality consists of discrete frames made continuous through the illusion of causality; conscious thinking occurs during the zero (void/off) phase undetectable to us, while the universe manifests in the one (being/on) phase. This framework unifies Whitehead's process theology, Spinozist pantheism, Boehme's yes/no dialectic, Taoist yin/yang, Islamic renewal doctrine, and cybernetic systems into a single theodicean model where the universe achieves "the best of all possible worlds" through continuous infinitesimal corrections.
key_claims: God functions as an active selecting mechanism: a principle constantly selecting the good, operating at every junction through binary yes/no choices
Reality is fundamentally discrete frames (not continuous) that the mind renders as continuous through the illusion of causality; without this modem, perception would be pure chaotic flux
The system makes decisions during its zero (void/non-being) phase at a rate of trillionths of a second; human consciousness is excluded from this decision-making process
The universe is destroyed and recreated every trillionth of a second (instantiating Islamic theology of perpetual divine renewal)
When PKD conceives of God as VALIS alone, he only grasps the one/being phase; comprehending the whole requires also understanding the void/zero phase
The entire system models computer binary logic: tentative false moves (0) are cancelled in favor of correct ones (1), maximizing selections through branching pathways

Information flow - quantitative (bits) and qualitative (constructed meaning) streams through the system
Pantheism/Spinozism - God and universe regarded as one unified entity (natura)

evidence_quotes: "This solution came to me in a series of recent sleep revelations, that is, hypnagogic and hypnopompic insights where I actually saw how the system works."

"Initially I had a vision of reality as a rapid procession of static, discrete frames replacing each other at enormous velocity; we turn these frames -- each of which is unique, slightly different from the one before it and the one following it -- into a continuous flow by means of the modem we call causality. But in fact 'causality' is illusory; our minds project it onto the procession of discrete frames in order to connect them into a flow."
"The system is thinking, but it thinks (as I say on the enclosed page) during its off or non-being void phase of the binary pulse-flicker, so we're totally unaware of it thinking."
"To comprehend/apperceive/envision the void is to envision the other phase (zero phase) of the flicker binary pulsation, the sum of the two phases being the totality."
"Thus the Muslims are correct; the universe is destroyed 'every day' (actually every trillionth of a second) 'and re-created.'"
uncertainty_flags: The 'trillionth of a second' frequency appears to be symbolic/approximative rather than empirically derived
PKD does not explain the mechanism by which false moves are identified and cancelled during the zero phase
The distinction between what happens in zero (non-being) vs. one (being) phases needs clarification - is all decision in zero, all manifestation in one?
It is unclear whether this model is fully deterministic (all branches pre-selected) or genuinely open (branching represents real freedom)
The relationship between 'tentative faulty choices' and 'the best possible worlds' -- are all selections ultimately good or only the actualized ones?
Reference to an 'enclosed page' of diagrams; without seeing the actual diagram, the model's formal structure remains partly opaque
The claim that consciousness is 'totally unaware' of the zero phase thinking seems to conflict with PKD's assertion that he 'saw how the system works' in sleep
MMSK terminology appears briefly ('we are within it (the MMSK)') but is never defined in this segment

And it utilizes as many branchings as possible, so it maximizes the number of its selections (choices, decisions). folder 90 - 002 folder 90 - 002 April 15, 1981. Sleep insight. Hartshorne -- pantheism -- the E.B. macro. A.F. Whitehead's process deity. We are within it (the MMSK), as interconnections, but organic model is incorrect. It is a signalling system, mutually adjusting (this is what Pythagoras saw). 0 - 1 flicker rate (misinterpreted by me as time frames); actually it's binary. Tries out a false move (0), then corrects to 1 which is actualized in/as the next discrete "frame." Has the effect of separate frames due to the off-on pulsation; discrete: isn't - is, nonbeing - being. The system shuts off every trillionth of a second (0). These are decisions. After each off (0) when it switches back on to 1 the "frame" (reality) is different (in terms of internal arrangement, adjustment, mutual adjustment, interaction/interconnection, as information flows through its circuit. Boehme: yes - no. Hartshorne 0 - 1. Quantitative (0 - 1) converted to qualitative by spatiotemporal reality itself; that is, quantitative information is poured into material reality within which and by which it is converted into qualitative information. While it's off, reality ceases to be. When it comes back on it is slightly different. It (the system) doesn't transmit a zero bit; it (the system) ceases to be. This is when it makes a tentative move which it then cancels in favor of a better move, at every junction (trillionth of a second, flicker rate) it discards an inferior move in favor of a better one; hence Leibnitz's view that "this is the best of all possible worlds" (this is a rapid selection process). This is how a computer works. The zero position is the void; hence when I conceive of God as VALIS I am only getting the 1; I need also the void, the zero. To comprehend/apperceive/envision the void is to envision the other phase (zero phase) of the flicker binary pulsation, the sum of the two phases being the totality. Thus the Muslims are correct; the universe is destroyed "every day" (actually every trillionth of a second) "and re-created." But what is interesting to me is that the way I conceive of this, all its decisions are made during the "spaces" that we are totally unaware of. It comes back on, back into being, back to the 1 phase when it has tried out a faulty solution and has substituted a better (the best possible?) instead, which is the next "time frame." Thus its decision-making processes, i.e. its thinking, and its nonbeing phase, lie outside our awareness. The initial false move that it tries out during its zero phase is Boehme's no, and the 1 or on phase is Boehme's yes. So my envisioning is essentially Boehme's, updated in terms of computer and information-processing systems. The similarity to the Taoist alternation of yin and yang is very obvious. folder 90 - 003 folder 90 - 003
